field.label: Enable Gotify
field.help: Send selected system notifications to your Gotify server independently of MAX and Telegram.

field.label: Server URL
field.help: Enter the Gotify server address, including any reverse-proxy path. HTTPS is recommended. Do not add /message to the address.

field.label: Application token
field.help: Use a token from a Gotify application, not a client token. For an HTTP server, the token travels without transport encryption.

field.label: Notification priority
field.help: Choose a value from 0 to 10. Higher values mean higher priority; the default is 5.
